likely_causes.cause: Board reporting a non-normal pattern from the installed label
Door switch, flame sense, or limit condition (pattern-dependent)

homeowner_checks: Write down the flash pattern from the board label inside the blower door
Replace the filter if a limit trip is suspected from weak airflow
Do not guess meanings from another brand's chart
tech_only: Flame sensor cleaning or gas valve work
call_pro_when: The installed LED table maps the pattern to a fault, or the pattern is unknown and the system will not run.
sources: config/led_codes.json (only normal_values are known; others are unknown)
assumptions: LED meanings come only from the installed profile table — never invented
Placeholder led_codes.json currently treats only 0 as normal
